description_en: Retrieves the event status information of agents in a Cloud Call Center instance
description_zh: 调用ListAgentEvents获取呼叫中心实例中坐席的事件状态信息
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-agent-events --instance-id d278629c-c687-4aa3-b044-4fe9b012e7ef --start-time 1555297200000 --stop-time 1555300800000 --ram-id example-string --event example-string --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentEvents

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance from which to retrieve agent information
parameters.help_zh: 待获取用户的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time.

The default value is one hour before the current time. The query time range must be less than one hour. Otherwise, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。

默认是当前时间前一小时，注意查询时间范围小于1小时，否则会报错
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Default value: the current time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，默认是当前时间
parameters.name: stop_time

parameters.help_en: The RAM ID of the agent
parameters.name: ram_id

parameters.help_en:
The event.

Valid values: SignIn, SignOut, Break, Ready, Ringing, Talking, Abandon, End, Processing, RequestHelp, HelpSuccess, ConferenceEstablished, ConferenceEnded, and Dialing
parameters.help_zh:
事件。

包括：”签入”,”签出”,”小休”,”等待”,”振铃”,”通话”,”放弃”,”结束”,”处理”,”发起求助”,”求助成功”,”会议建立”,”会议结束”,”拨号”
parameters.name: event
